title: CENTA Studentships
about: Project-based PhD studentships for autumn 2027 entry across CENTA host institutions in the UK, with projects such as machine learning for water-quality prediction and health risks from heat and air pollution. Applications close 23:59 GMT, Wednesday 6 January 2027.
requirements: Apply to an advertised CENTA project
Also apply separately to the host university; CENTA offers depend on the university offer

upskill.name: Data Analytics
why: "Environmental and Earth sciences" / project "machine learning for water-quality prediction" → A005.16 "Apply environmental and climate data analytics to investigate complex patterns" (score 5.8, below course_min_score 6, so linked to the Academy page, not a specific course)
